name: mite
description: Mite is a time tracking tool designed to help businesses and freelancers efficiently manage their time and projects. It offers features such as time tracking, reporting, and invoicing, making it easier to keep track of work hours and project progress.

events.d: Retrieve the connected Mite account's details (id, name, title, currency, created and updated timestamps).
Retrieve the currently running tracker for the connected user, with entry id, minutes tracked, and start time.
Fetch all bookmarks for the connected account.
Retrieve active customers, optionally filtered by name and paginated using limit and page.
List active projects; filter by name or customer_id, and use limit and page for pagination.
Retrieve archived projects, optionally filter by name or customer ID, and set page or limit.
List active (non-archived) services; optionally filter by name and paginate with limit/page.
Retrieve archived services, with optional name filter and pagination.
List archived users, optionally filtered by name or email and paginated using limit and page.
List active users, filterable by name or email, with limit and page options.
